notes.title: v1.0.8
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- [Combat] Fixed corruption debuff removal doing damage.
- [Scientist] Buying Combat or Gathering experience now correctly consumes items.

notes.title: v1.0.7
notes.content:
Features
- [Scientist] Added a way to earn gathering and combat experience from science products.
- [Manufacturer] Added 2 new recipes: Gathering Knowledge and Combat Knowledge.
- [Invasions] Added leaderboard rank based on highest invasion score.
- [Taskmaster] Added a new perk to automatically claim tasks.
- [UI] Added an item tracker for the Scientist and Taskmaster.

Changes
- [Manufacturer] Reduced Depleted Uranium, Astral Alloy and Prismatic Core ingredient requirements.
- [Achievements] Reduced Jackpot requirement from 420 to 42 for "Stonks".
- [Save] Reduced manual cloud save cooldown. The button fill now correctly represents this cooldown.

Bug Fixes
- [Performance] Fixed performance issues from invasions.
- [Offline] Fixed a time calculation issue that prevented some bounties and expeditions to progress offline.
- [Combat] Removing corruption won't trigger its damage effect anymore.
- [Combat] Drones won't shoot after they are destroyed anymore.
- [Misc] Various typo fixes.

notes.title: v1.0.6
notes.content:
Changes

 [Elites] Changed cores drop rate from 50% to 100%.


Bug Fixes

 [Engineer] The engineer won't reset the last selected fusion target now.
 [Bounty] Fixed an issue with bounty hunter offline gains.
 [Combat] Autorepair should not stop working randomly anymore.

notes.title: v1.0.5
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

 [Bounty] Bounty durations are now aligned with Taskmaster bonuses.
 [Invasions] Fixed performance issues when running invasion for a while.
 [Audio] Fixed explosion sounds when opening an elite enemy activity.
 [Engineer] Output selection is now locked when performing fusions.
 [Manufacturer] Added a failsafe to stop from launching a craft with no available cargo space.

notes.title: v1.0.4
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

 [Save] Fixed a critical issue preventing some players to start the game.

notes.title: v1.0.3
notes.content:
Changes

 [Manufacturer] Drastically reduced emitter crafting input materials.


Bug Fixes

 [Bounty] Fixed bounties offline gains rewarding credits as an item instead of currency.
 [Overseer] Fixed a visual bug showing active nodes even if they were turned off.
 [Misc] Fixed some typos.

notes.title: v1.0.2
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

- [Combat] Fixed a memory issue causing combat to drop performances after a while.
- [Bounty] Bounty Hunter offline gains are now correctly applied.
- [Ship] The last used Repair & Ammo will now be selected when launching the game.
- [Gathering] Fix attempt at gathering sometimes randomly stopping (to be confirmed).
- [Meta] Reduced Vulkan hyperdrive level to 35, to make it correctly accessible.

notes.title: v1.0.1
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

 [Crew] Fixed crew members upgrades not using the correct item
 [Gambler] Fixed jackpot pool going beyond cap
 [Bounty] Fixed bounties running for ever
